reasons: Status is correctly characterised as a deviation: Section 12(b) provides only a TrueLink indemnity for its own breach/non-performance, with no duty to defend and no IP infringement, breach-of-law, data-disclosure or gross negligence/wilful misconduct limbs — exactly the gap the rule targets.

The redline reaches the preferred position with a contained edit: 'defend' is added to p0073 and limbs (ii)-(v) plus a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure are appended to the existing sentence in p0075, preserving the original breach limb as limb (i).

The failed deterministic check 'vendor indemnity for IP infringement present' is a phrasing artefact — the inserted text expressly covers claims 'alleging that the Interface... infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual property right of any third party', which satisfies the rule; the 0.863 change ratio on p0075 reflects that this is a one-line clause into which the required limbs must be inserted.
Comment is accurate, correctly cites the playbook position and offers the sanctioned fallback (usual exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies) without lecturing; tone and prefix conform.

Follow-up (non-blocking): the preferred position also calls for Client's indemnity to be narrowed to Client-provided content and Client's breach of law — limbs 12(a)(ii) and (iv) (and the 'without regard to any knowledge limitation' language) remain broader than the playbook contemplates and should be trimmed in the same negotiation pass. Also confirm 'Hosting Services' and 'Support Services' are defined terms in this agreement, or rely on the catch-all wording.
